issue: lubʰyómes is PRS.1PL 'we long for' but the English asks 'Do you long for your home?' (2sg); should be lubʰyési.
h₁ésyeh₂s 'her' where the grandmother's own grandson/silver would take reflexive swó- (swéh₂s/swóm); not ungrammatical.
sḱéh₃ih₂h₁ is NOM/ACC.DU 'two shadows'; 'cover me with shadow' needs INS.SG sḱh₃yéh₂h₁.
témHesos is GEN/ABL; 'May your house burn in the darkness' wants LOC témHesi (as in the other texts). Genitive of time is possible but not what the English/plan says.
bʰéretām is 3DU (imperfect/imperative) 'the two of them carried'; 'Wife, bring gold and wool' needs IMP.2SG bʰére.
ḱm̥tóm gʷṓs: acc. pl. in apposition to 'hundred' where gen. pl. gʷówom is the commoner construction.
lewbʰóyh₁ is neuter NOM/ACC.DU of lewbʰos; the address 'beloved!' needs VOC.SG masc léwbʰe.
